notes:
Summary: Large enterprise search vendor for retail+knowledge management. Primary need: massive-scale embedding store and accurate reranking with tight unit economics.
- Target index size: 200M -> 1B vectors (phase 1: 200M ingest, phase 2: 800M).
- Embedding model: customers prefer open 3rd-party embeddings (custom finetune possibility) but want Redwood-hosted embeddings option for ops.
- Reranking: hybrid flow — ANN (approx k=100) then cross-encoder rerank top-16. P99 latency target for customer query (ANN+rerank): <120ms on Dedicated; interactive search path ~ <80ms for short queries.
- Throughput: steady-state 1.5k-3k QPS during peak; background batch re-indexing windows overnight.
- Cost goal: unit cost per query (end-to-end) < $0.0005 to justify replacing legacy retrieval stack; strong interest in quantization + batching to reduce cost.
- Data residency: EU/NA split customers; must satisfy residency + audit logging.
- Security: SSO/SAML, strict KMS with HSM option, 7-year audit retention for some regulated clients.
- Integration: heavy use of pre-existing vector pipeline (Kafka -> vectorizer -> ingestion); want Redwood to accept streamed bulk ingestion with backpressure semantics and idempotent writes.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, latency per route, per-model dashboards are a must.
- Quote sensitivity: will compare Dedicated vs self-hosted solutions (Milvus + custom infra) for TCO; Redwood Optimize recommendations + autoscaling are strong differentiators.
- Quote/POC asks: proof-of-performance run on customer sample (50M vectors) with real queries, ingestion throughput bench, end-to-end cost per q calculation, and a dark-launch canary for 2 weeks.
Call notes (sales cadence):
- 2026-01-12 intro (Avery/Jordan) — "We need predictable unit economics at scale — if you can get <$0.0005/q and p99 <120ms we move to pilot." Fireflies ff_2026-01-12_zephyrus-p0.
- 2026-02-02 ingestion test kickoff (SE-led) — ingest 50M vectors; showed index size and baseline ANN recall.
- 2026-02-22 perf run — ANN top-100 latency 28ms, cross-encoder rerank (top-16 full forward) additional 65-90ms depending on model; combined ~110-140ms depending on batch. Notes: batching can lower avg but not p99 without dedicated small-model rerankers. Fireflies ff_2026-02-22_perf-run.
- Security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-25 (drive path above).
POC requirements checklist:
- Demo dataset: 50M canonical doc vectors, 10M user query traces for distribution.
- Ingestion throughput: target 200k vectors/hour (phase 1), scale tests to 1M+/hour for next phase.
- SLO validation: p50/p90/p99 latency for retrieval path; sustained 2k QPS simulation.
- Cost model: detailed per-token + per-inference cost, accounting for reranker model multiplies and caching savings.
- Autoscaling behavior: need warm pools for rerankers to hit p99; request Redwood show cold-start/responsiveness metrics.
Remarks: technical stakeholders favor Redwood runtime optimizations (KV/prefix cache, continuous batching, kernel selection). Business stakeholders focused on TCO and vendor lock-in risk.
